case.summary: Transaction 3526826 ($35.66, online) on card C07671-K2 was triggered solely by an uncorroborated legacy risk score of 0.76. In contrast, the calibrated fraud model scored the transaction at 0.006 with an expected historical fraud rate of 0.6%. Account analysis showed steady normal activity across 135 transactions in the two-week window with no testing sequences or bursts, and the holder identity has no prior fraud history. The alert was determined to be a false alarm and closed as legitimate.
